text:
sophia: Heads-up — opened a PR that changes how on-prem nodes fetch secrets. It's #4523 and touches authn/authz plus VPC routing for private deployments. Can someone from sec review? I'm trying to get this merged in the next merge window.
sophia: Main change: switch from in-repo creds + env overrides to KMS-backed temporary creds fetched at startup. There is a fallback file path for dev but prod on-prem will use KMS via the customer HSM shim.
sec-bot: Automated scan: PR 4523 — dependency policy OK, but flagged missing KMS key rotation doc and IAM binding check for the shim service account. See https://ci.internal/redwood/pr/4523/scan
jess: Looking now. Quick question: does the shim require any inbound ports on customer VPC peers? I want to confirm there is no plane that opens new ingress rules to the customer's network.
rahul: @jess no new inbound from customer VPC. The shim is egress-only to the KMS endpoint in the same VPC peering. Config snippet:
```
# on-prem agent config
kms:
  endpoint: https://kms.internal.redwood
  auth: service-account
  mode: hsm-shim
network:
  egress: [kms, logs]
  inbound: []
```
rahul: The only change to VPC routes is an explicit egress rule to the KMS endpoint IPs (we already had logging egress). I added a note in the PR description about route tables and required firewall entries.
jess: OK that helps. Two things before LGTM:
1) Add a short rotation plan for the HSM/KMS keys (how often + steps) — high level is fine.
2) Add an integration test that simulates a KMS failure and verifies the fallback doesn't leak secrets to disk.
toni: FYI if we merge this in the upcoming window (today 15:00 UTC), infra-oncall needs the rollout plan because it touches on-prem agents. Pinged @infra-oncall channel. If we miss the window we should schedule first thing tomorrow.
sophia: I can add the rotation doc — will drop it in the PR. For the integration test, I have a small simulated KMS that returns 503; I can wire that into the test harness and assert that the dev fallback only writes to tmpfs and is wiped on shutdown. Will push in the next commit.
sec-bot: Reminder: run e2e-privacy and dependency-checker before merge. Policy requires both green for anything that touches secrets handlers.
jess: Once those updates land I can do a final security sign-off. Also, please add a short changelog blurb for Private/VPC installers describing the egress requirement.
rahul: Will add changelog + tests + rotation plan in a follow-up commit in ~20m. CI might take ~12m to finish.
sophia: Thanks all. Tagging this as merge-after-ci unless jess requests a second pass. I'll coordinate with @toni on infra handoff if we end up merging in the 15:00 UTC window. :thumbsup:
toni: Sounds good. If jess signs off before 14:50 UTC I'll coordinate the infra checklist and stand by for rollout. :calendar:
jess: Great — leaving a review comment with one tiny nit and the checklist items. Not blocking, will re-check after the tests are in.
